decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.00 a.m.  to 6.00 p.m.  on Mondays to Friday and 9.00 a.m.  to 6.00 p.m.  on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The shop premises shall not be open to customers outside the hours of 9.00 am to 8.00 pm Monday to Friday, 9.00 a.m to 6.00 p.m. on Saturdays and 10.00 a.m. to 4.00 p.m. on Sundays, unless prior written approval is obtained from the Local Planning Authority. Deliveries to the premises shall be within these times.

Condition : 6 - The development hereby permitted shall only be used for the retail sales of automobile accessories, bicycles and bicycle accessories, and other related products and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in class A1 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 or any Order revoking or enacting that Order.
Condition : 7 - Ancillary fitting of vehicles shall not include tyre or exhaust fitting or any industrial activity outside Class B1 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987.

Condition : 8 - Before the development commences details of parking (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before first occupation of any part of the development.

Condition : 9 - Reason for Approval: The scheme, subject to the conditions which have been imposed, will not be harmful to the viability of Chiswick Town Centre, and subject to the conditions which have been imposed will be in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1., S.3.1 and T.1.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan.
description: Use of ground floor for activities falling within class (A1) retail use
